messages:
pagerbot: INCIDENT ⚠️ High p99 latency and increased 5xx rate detected for /v1/generate (hosted-api). Alert threshold crossed at 1773334444. Dashboard: https://internal.redwood.io/d/alloc/hosted-api?panel=latency

charlie.sre: oncall here. pulling traces now — when did the last deploy go out?

alice.dev: I pushed canary at 1773334300 (release/2026-03-17.12). Noticed a small queueing bump during smoke but rolled forward.

charlie.sre: ok. seeing p95 from 120ms -> 850ms, p99 spiking to ~3.4s. 5xx (502/504) count increased ~6x in last 2m. Traces show long connect/response from runtime pool.

charlie.sre: tagging @alice.dev and @tim.product. @liz.support FYI — customer-facing errors likely.

alice.dev: thanks. checking canary nodes logs. running: `kubectl logs -l release=2026-03-17.12 --since=5m | grep -i error`

alice.dev: log snippet:
```
2026-03-17T12:03:21Z WARN runtime: kv-cache miss, warming
2026-03-17T12:03:22Z ERROR connection: timeout waiting for backend (gpu-node-07)
2026-03-17T12:03:23Z ERROR http: upstream 502 gateway timeout
```

charlie.sre: seeing similar stack on prod traffic routed to that canary slice. Also CPU on backend nodes is normal but socket queues backlog growing. Could be kernel/keepalive flags or new runtime change.

deploy-bot: rollback recommended: release/2026-03-17.12 has rollback window open. Run `/deploy rollback release/2026-03-17.12` to revert.

charlie.sre: decision: initiate immediate rollback to release/2026-03-17.11 to restore SLOs. Notifying exec path.

alice.dev: rolling back now — `deployctl rollback --release=2026-03-17.12 --target=hosted-api --force` (started 1773334485)

charlie.sre: paging ops to watch traffic migration and K/V warmups. Also enable fallback routing to model-variant B for latency-sensitive routes.

liz.support: opening incident ticket INC-2026-0317-01 and sending initial customer notice draft to sales for review. Early estimate: ~0.4% of requests saw 5xx in the last 10m, concentrated on region us-east-1.

alice.dev: rollback complete on hosted-api at 1773334502. `deployctl status` -> all slices healthy, old pods back.

charlie.sre: metrics: p99 back down to 150ms within ~30s post-rollback. 5xx returned to baseline. Confirming no lingering tail.

tim.product: thanks — can you estimate customer impact window and which customers hit errors?

liz.support: correlating error logs with API keys — initial list shows 3 enterprise keys with elevated 5xx (total ~1200 failed requests). Draft sent to account reps.

charlie.sre: I'll keep monitoring for 15m, then handoff to oncall rotation. Need follow-up: root cause (KV warmup change?), why canary passed smoke, and how to improve pre-rollout tracing for keepalive/backpressure.

alice.dev: capturing full trace dump and runtime config diff between 2026-03-17.11 and .12. Pushing to /incidents/1773334444/artifacts.

charlie.sre: final on-call notes: rollback successful, customer impact limited but non-zero. Created postmortem placeholder: https://go.redwood/pm/INC-2026-0317-01. Assigning owners: alice.dev (root cause), charlie.sre (mitigation & monitoring), liz.support (customer comms). Handoff to @charlie.sre for next 15m watch. :white_check_mark:

liz.support: will update customers after watch window. thanks team.
